current_disclosures.section: Note 7 - Cash Equivalents and Marketable Securities
current_disclosures.summary: Beginning in Q2 fiscal year 2025, publicly-held equity securities from non-affiliated entities previously in other assets were reclassified as marketable securities. Net unrealized gains on these securities were $163 million in FY2025, while net realized gains on sold securities were $88 million. Gains for prior years (2023-2024) were not significant.

comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 28, 2024, the Company held non-marketable securities in privately-held companies with an estimated fair value of $468 million, recorded using Level 3 inputs, compared to $155 million in the prior year.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose holdings of non-marketable equity securities in privately-held companies valued using Level 3 inputs, but they differ significantly in reported amounts and the treatment of marketable securities. NVDA reports $225 million in marketable equity securities with no significant gains/losses, while AMD focuses on a larger ($468 million) non-marketable portfolio with no mention of similar marketable equity balances in this specific context.

sentences.text: Marketable equity securities totaled $225 million and $11 million as of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, respectively.
The net unrealized and realized gains and losses of investments in marketable securities net were not significant for fiscal years 2024, 2023 and 2022.

As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had non-marketable securities in privately-held companies of $468 million and $155 million, respectively, which are recorded at estimated fair value based on Level 3 inputs.

comparisons.peer_topic: Recognition of gains and losses on equity investments
comparisons.peer_summary: Realized and unrealized gains and losses from fair value changes or sales are recorded in 'gains (losses) on equity investments, net,' and the carrying value of non-marketable investments is adjusted for qualifying observable price changes determined by judgment on security rights.
comparisons.comparison: NVDA and INTC both address the recognition of gains and losses on equity investments, but they diverge in the significance of those gains. NVDA states that net unrealized and realized gains/losses on marketable securities were not significant, whereas INTC provides a broader accounting policy for both realized/unrealized gains/losses from fair value changes or sales and adjustments for observable price changes in non-marketable investments.

sentences.text: Our marketable equity securities have readily determinable fair values and are recorded as long-term other assets on our Consolidated Balance Sheets at fair value with changes in fair value recorded in Other income and expense, net on our Consolidated Statements of Income.
The net unrealized and realized gains and losses of investments in marketable securities net were not significant for fiscal years 2024, 2023 and 2022.
Realized and unrealized gains and losses resulting from changes in fair value or the sale of our equity investments are recorded in gains (losses) on equity investments, net.

The carrying value of our non-marketable equity investments is adjusted for qualifying observable price changes resulting from the issuance of similar or identical securities in an orderly transaction by the same issuer.

comparisons.peer_topic: Non-marketable equity investment balances and valuation
comparisons.peer_summary: The company held non-marketable equity investments without readily determinable fair values of $190 million as of August 29, 2024, and $218 million as of August 31, 2023. These investments are classified as Level 3 and recorded at fair value on a non-recurring basis.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and MU disclose non-marketable equity investments without readily determinable fair values classified as Level 3. However, NVDA's disclosure highlights marketable equity securities with readily determinable fair values and reports a substantial increase in this category ($225 million vs $11 million), whereas MU focuses exclusively on the non-marketable portion ($190 million) recorded at fair value on a non-recurring basis.

sentences.text: Our investments in non-affiliated entities include marketable equity securities, which are publicly traded, and non-marketable equity securities, which are primarily investments in privately held companies.
Marketable equity securities totaled $225 million and $11 million as of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, respectively.

In addition to the amounts included in the table above, we had $190 million and $218 million of non-marketable equity investments without a readily determinable fair value that were included in other noncurrent assets as of August 29, 2024 and August 31, 2023, respectively.
Our non-marketable equity investments are recorded at fair value on a non-recurring basis and classified as Level 3.
